findings.claim: The lockfile importer records `vite` with specifier `8.1.4` while `frontend/package.json` declares `^8.1.4`, so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (CI default) fails with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE.
findings.evidence: package.json hunk: `"vite": "^8.1.4"`; lockfile hunk: `-        specifier: ^8.1.3\n+        specifier: 8.1.4`. pnpm records the importer specifier verbatim from package.json and treats any divergence as an out-of-date lockfile. Every other changed dependency in the same importer matches its manifest spec exactly (`@tailwindcss/vite: 4.3.3`, `tailwindcss: 4.3.3`, `chromatic: ^18.1.0`), proving the lockfile was not regenerated against the shipped package.json.
findings.suggested_fix: Either pin `"vite": "8.1.4"` in package.json or regenerate the lockfile with `pnpm install` so the recorded specifier is `^8.1.4`.

findings.claim: The root lockfile changes `frontend/packages/a2ui-core`'s vite importer specifier from `^8.1.3` to `8.1.4` without any corresponding change to that package's `package.json`, which is absent from the diff, producing the same frozen-lockfile breakage at the root workspace.
findings.evidence: Root lockfile hunk: `       vite:\n-        specifier: ^8.1.3\n+        specifier: 8.1.4` under `frontend/packages/a2ui-core`; the diff contains no edit to `frontend/packages/a2ui-core/package.json`, so its manifest still declares `^8.1.3`. The same pattern repeats for the root lockfile's `frontend` importer (`specifier: 8.1.4` vs manifest `^8.1.4`).
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate the root lockfile with `pnpm install` from the shipped manifests, or update the affected packages' package.json specs to match what was locked.

findings.claim: The lockfile assertion deliberately tolerates the specifier/manifest mismatch instead of catching it, masking the frozen-install failure.
findings.evidence: `if (devDependencies.vite !== "^8.1.4")` demands the caret in package.json, while the lockfile regex `/specifier: \^?8\.1\.4/` explicitly makes the caret optional — the script passes on exactly the inconsistent state that breaks CI, and verification.md cites this script as evidence for criterion 4.1.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert exact equality between the manifest spec and the recorded lockfile specifier (e.g. `specifier: ^8.1.4` if the manifest keeps the caret).

findings.claim: The `.light` and system-light blocks override only five of the seven run-phase colors, leaving `--color-phase-skill: #f59e0b` and `--color-phase-memory: #8b5cf6` at their dark-theme values in light mode.
findings.evidence: The `@theme` block defines `--color-phase-skill: #f59e0b`; `.light` overrides `--color-phase-context/retrieval/reasoning/tool/generate` (and swaps the sibling status color `--color-amber` from `#f59e0b` to `#d97706`) but never touches `--color-phase-skill` or `--color-phase-memory`. `#f59e0b` on the light `--color-bg: #f7f7f8` is roughly 2:1 contrast, and the script's light-parity loop only iterates `roleMap`, which contains no phase roles, so the omission is not caught.
findings.suggested_fix: Add light-theme values for `--color-phase-skill` and `--color-phase-memory` to both `.light` and the `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light)` block, and extend the parity assertion to phase roles.

findings.claim: Task 4.2 is marked complete even though one of its named gates, `pnpm -C frontend lint`, currently fails.
findings.evidence: acceptance_criteria/task 4.2 (`Run frontend typecheck, lint, ...`) is `[x]`, but verification.md states: "`pnpm -C frontend lint` was run and did not pass" and "Phase exit still requires a green repository-wide lint gate." The deferral rationale (generated-artifact ownership) is documented, but the checked task asserts the gate was satisfied as written.
findings.suggested_fix: Either split task 4.2 to record lint as a blocked sub-item, or annotate the task line so downstream archive gating does not read 9/9 as all-green.
